verified_current_limits: Resident does not currently perform independent repository commits from its normal conversation surface.
Resident does not currently perform independent restore/write-back from its normal conversation surface.
The standalone App Truth scanner is primarily a Bridge-screen contract scanner, not a complete whole-app change validator.
Safe Writer can commit with a manually entered GitHub token, but it targets direct protected transactions rather than a complete candidate-branch promotion architecture.
Code Safety restore write-back is described as not connected in the audited UI.
Resident wrappers inside Safe Writer and Code Safety guide and copy handoffs; they do not independently control the underlying tools.
Bug Mixer predictions are hypotheses, not validated bugs.
The audited system does not yet prove automatic affected-test selection, candidate identity binding, independent outer-guardian approval, or tested-to-promoted identity equality.
The reasoning/model connection used by the current integrated Resident has not yet been fully audited and remains HOLD until documented.

preservation_contract.law: No existing Resident capability may be silently removed, renamed, bypassed, or semantically weakened during the Safe Change Architecture build.
replacement_requirements: behavioral equivalence or intentional improvement tested
high_risk_protected_objects: Last Good and pinned emergency pointers

architecture_entry_rule: The Resident Safe Change Architecture must begin with this inventory as Protected Section 1. Architecture requirements may add or strengthen capabilities, but may not subtract an existing capability without the replacement requirements passing.
safe_claim: The known current Resident capability set has been inventoried from direct repository evidence with watch and is ready to become the protected starting point for the Resident Safe Change Architecture.
do_not_claim: Do not claim the full repository history is audited, every legacy Resident file is understood, Resident can already code independently, or the Safe Change Architecture is implemented.
